labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Reports unexpected test failures after a Pygments upgrade, but gives no runnable example

labels.name: more information needed
labels.rationale: Needs a minimal reproduction, Rich version and rich.diagnose output

items.body:
Thanks for the report. To look into the test failures, we need a minimal runnable example, the Rich version you are using, and your platform. Please run `python -m rich.diagnose` and paste its output here. If you can, include the specific failing test names and a short snippet that reproduces the difference in output.

A related earlier report about test failures with a newer Pygments is #3088.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
